sql:
SELECT
  request_type,
  status,
  count(*) AS request_count,
  min(received_at)::date AS earliest_received_at,
  max(received_at)::date AS latest_received_at,
  round(
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (completed_at - received_at)) / 86400.0
    ) FILTER (WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL),
    1
  ) AS median_days_to_close
FROM data_subject_requests
GROUP BY request_type, status
ORDER BY request_type, status
